name: Abingdon
about: Abingdon Wine Estate is located in the KwaZulu-Natal Midlands near Lidgetton — one of the very few wine estates outside the Western Cape. Established in 2004, the estate grows vines at 1100m+ altitude in summer-rainfall conditions completely different to the Mediterranean climate of the Cape. Their Sauvignon Blanc is crisp, herbaceous, and nervy — a rare and fascinating wine that challenges assumptions about where SA wine can be grown.

name: Asara
about: Asara Wine Estate sits on the slopes of the Simonsberg near Stellenbosch, combining a luxury hotel, fine dining, and wine production in one of the most scenic settings in the Winelands. The estate produces elegant Bordeaux-style reds and crisp Sauvignon Blancs from vineyards that benefit from the cooling afternoon breezes off False Bay.

name: Aslina
about: Founded by Ntsiki Biyela — South Africa's first black female winemaker — Aslina is a pioneering brand that sources fruit from carefully selected Western Cape vineyards. Biyela broke barriers when she joined Stellekaya in 2004 after graduating from Stellenbosch University, then launched her own label in 2016 to international acclaim. Her Cabernet Sauvignon and Chardonnay reflect both her meticulous winemaking and her journey transforming SA wine.

The brandies are aged in French oak for a minimum of three years, developing complex notes of caramel, dried fruit, walnut, and spice. KWV's 10- and 20-year-old brandies are among the finest spirits produced in Africa.

about: Saronsberg is a premium estate in the Tulbagh valley, established in 2002 on land that has been farmed since the 18th century. The estate's Shiraz is pepper-driven, dark, and structured — among the best wines from this emerging region, benefiting from the valley's diverse soils and dramatic diurnal temperature shifts.

about: Skilpadvlei ('Tortoise Marsh') is a family estate in Stellenbosch producing broad-range value wines. Named for the tortoises that still roam the property, the estate is known for approachable Pinotage and Chenin Blanc at one of the best price-to-quality ratios in the Cape.

name: Slanghoek
about: Slanghoek Wine Cellar is a family-run co-op in the Slanghoek Valley, one of the most scenic parts of the Breedekloof. The valley's amphitheatre of mountains creates a unique microclimate that gives their Chenin Blanc and Colombard a crisp, aromatic character.

about: Winshaw is a family estate producing a broad range of wines from mature Stellenbosch vineyards. Their Cabernet Sauvignon is approachable and well-priced — a solid everyday-drinking red that represents good value in the competitive Stellenbosch market.

about: Yonder Hill is a family estate on the slopes above Stellenbosch, combining wine production with a restaurant and accommodation. Their Merlot is generous and soft — a crowd-pleasing Stellenbosch red that pairs well with the estate's farm-style menu.

name: Zorgvliet
about: Zorgvliet ('Care Free') is a historic estate in the Banghoek Valley, one of Stellenbosch's coolest and most scenic sub-regions. The estate is known for its Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc, produced from vineyards on steep, south-facing slopes, and for its acclaimed restaurant overlooking the valley.
